label: TP
reason: Both alerts are true positives. Alert 1 (XSS): User input from request header flows through URL decoding and doSomething() to bar, then to fileName which is HTML-encoded before output - but per triage policy, attacker-controlled resolved sink value warrants TP even with encoding present. Alert 2 (Path Injection): Same user-controlled flow reaches new File(fileName) sink, enabling potential path traversal. Code flow confirms taint from getHeader() through param/bar to fileName.

Tainted param flows through doSomething() helper to create bar variable

Path injection sink: new File(fileName) uses attacker-controlled fileName
